'''Scabaras lancers''' are aggressive monsters encountered during the [[Dealing with Scabaras]] quest. They can be used for the [[Scabarites]] slayer assignment. They are a source of [[Scabarite notes]] for the [[Scabarites Notes]] miniquest.
